why.title: One resume is not enough for every job.
why.subtitle: A generic resume is not enough because every job ad has different priorities, keywords, and proof expectations. Recruiters and ATS systems look for role-specific relevance.
why.bridge: One base resume -> one targeted application for this specific job -> better ATS readiness -> better interview preparation.

role.title: Every job ad has a different signal
role.description: Job descriptions use specific skills, tools, responsibilities, and wording. Watheq starts with the job ad so your resume can speak to this role, not just any role.

ats.title: Generic resumes hide your best proof
ats.description: Relevant achievements can disappear when they are buried or framed for another role. Watheq helps surface the strongest real evidence for this application.

proof.title: Tailoring should stay truthful
proof.description: Watheq improves positioning while preserving your real experience, asking clarifying questions before rewriting when proof is missing.

truth.title: Watheq improves the application around your real evidence.
truth.subtitle: The workflow is built to reduce generic rewrites and unsupported claims by matching first, asking when proof is missing, and keeping interview prep tied to the same source material.

match.title: Job matching before rewriting
match.description: Watheq compares the resume to the job ad so optimization starts from actual gaps, keywords, and role expectations.

clarify.title: Questions before assumptions
clarify.description: When impact is vague, Watheq asks for scope, metrics, or context before turning a bullet into a stronger claim.

noFakes.title: No fake experience
noFakes.description: Suggestions are framed as defensible improvements, not invented credentials, employers, numbers, or responsibilities.
